GDMA Exported Types

group GDMA_Exported_Types
struct GDMA_InitTypeDef

GDMA init structure definition.

Public Members

uint8_t GDMA_ChannelNum

Specify the channel number for GDMA. This parameter can be set from 0 to 9. Refer to GDMA Channel Num.

GDMADirection_TypeDef GDMA_DIR

Specify transfer direction. This parameter can be a value of GDMA Data Transfer Direction.

uint32_t GDMA_BufferSize

Specify the buffer size(RTL8762G <= 65535, RTL8772F: GDMA1 is 65535 and GDMA2 is 524287). The data unit is equal to the configuration set in DMA_PeripheralDataSize or DMA_MemoryDataSize members depending in the transfer direction.

GDMASrcInc_TypeDef GDMA_SourceInc

Specify whether the source address register is incremented or not. This parameter can be a value of GDMA Source Incremented Mode.

GDMADestInc_TypeDef GDMA_DestinationInc

Specify whether the destination address register is incremented or not. This parameter can be a value of GDMA Destination Incremented Mode.

GDMADataSize_TypeDef GDMA_SourceDataSize

Specify the source data width. This parameter can be a value of GDMA Data Size.

GDMADataSize_TypeDef GDMA_DestinationDataSize

Specify the destination data width. This parameter can be a value of GDMA Data Size.

GDMAMSize_TypeDef GDMA_SourceMsize

Specify items number to be transferred. This parameter can be a value of GDMA Msize.

GDMAMSize_TypeDef GDMA_DestinationMsize

Specify items number to be transferred. This parameter can be a value of GDMA Msize.

uint32_t GDMA_SourceAddr

Specify the source base address for GDMA Channelx.

uint32_t GDMA_DestinationAddr

Specify the destination base address for GDMA Channelx.

uint32_t GDMA_ChannelPriority

Specify the software priority for the GDMA Channelx. This parameter can be a value of 0~9(RTL8762G); 0~7 for GDMA1 and 0~15 for GDMA2(RTL8772F).

uint32_t GDMA_Multi_Block_Mode

Specify the multi block transfer mode.

uint32_t GDMA_Multi_Block_Struct

Pointer to the first struct of LLI.

uint8_t GDMA_Multi_Block_En

Enable or disable multi-block function. This parameter can be a value of DISABLE or ENABLE.

uint8_t GDMA_SourceHandshake

Specify the handshake index in source. This parameter can be a value of GDMA Handshake Type.

uint8_t GDMA_DestHandshake

Specify the handshake index in Destination. This parameter can be a value of GDMA Handshake Type.

uint8_t GDMA_Secure_En

Enable or disable Secure function.

struct GDMA_LLIDef

GDMA link list item structure definition.

Public Members

uint32_t SAR

Specify the source base address for LLI.

uint32_t DAR

Specify the destination base address for LLI.

uint32_t LLP

Specify the next pointer to the struct of LLI.

uint32_t CTL_LOW

Specify the CTL_LOW register for LLI.

uint32_t CTL_HIGH

Specify the CTL_HIGH register for LLI.
